reviewed_by: Codex review of current String_FindExtension body against Binary Ninja, Radare2, and Ghidra/REA evidence; candidate body is unchanged from reviewed implementation.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Radare2, Binary Ninja, and Ghidra/REA identify the entry at 0x004B1E90 and 75-byte body through 0x004B1EDA. Ghidra calls it FUN_004b1e90; String_FindExtension is a descriptive catalog alias based on the recovered behavior, not a retail symbol.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Ghidra and Radare2 show three x86 cdecl stack arguments: destination pointer at [ESP+4], signed max_len at [ESP+8], and path pointer at [ESP+0xC]. The candidate signature preserves that layout.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail compares bytes with 0x2E (period), decrements the maximum copy count by one, then writes a NUL at destination[max_len-1]. Candidate follows the same operations for positive lengths.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail scans the NUL-terminated input path backward, returns a pointer into that path, and optionally writes to the destination buffer. Differential comparison normalizes the returned pointer to an offset and checks the full guarded destination buffer.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: When destination is non-null, retail calls its in-binary copy routine at 0x004A5500 with max_len-1, then writes the final terminator. angr executed both retail bodies; the candidate copy and final write matched for all tested inputs.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The null-destination path returns the pointer into the original path without writing the destination. Non-null positive-length cases compare the returned offset and destination state.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The function uses integer and byte operations only.

limits: angr VEX executed the retail PE body and internal callee, not a live Windows IGI process.
Behavioral comparison covered 12 NUL-terminated ASCII paths with positive destination lengths and the null-destination path.
Non-positive max_len, invalid pointers, overlapping buffers, non-ASCII byte sequences, and full integration callers are not established.
The descriptive String_FindExtension name is a catalog alias; Ghidra reports FUN_004b1e90.

angr CFGFast partitions the REPNE SCASB sequence at 0x004B1E9D and the following NOT/DEC at 0x004B1E9F, while Binary Ninja, Radare2, and Ghidra use the six-block partition; raw angr CFG scoring is diagnostic and not treated as proof.
